sentence_stem: Tom can swim very fast, but
full_sentence: Tom can swim very fast, but he can't ride a bicycle.

options.why_wrong: This gives a fact about Tom's height, not an ability that contrasts with swimming.

options.text: he can swim in the sea too.
options.why_wrong: This adds another ability in the same area, so it does not show the contrast that 'but' introduces.
This contradicts the first part of the sentence, which says Tom swims very fast.

grammar_focus: Can / can't for ability, with 'but' to contrast two abilities
explanation: After 'but', we need a clause that shows the opposite ability to the first clause. 'Can't' is the negative form of 'can' when talking about ability.
translation: Tom puede nadar muy rápido, pero no puede andar en bicicleta.
